'''2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Mountain View) Cat Ceder DII - Pre-Release Deck''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Cat Ceder]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 2–2 at [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Mountain View)]]. The post calls this 'My Dark Side Pre-Release deck' and says 'I went 2/2 with this deck', pointing to the author's tournament report 'Mt.View CA 062400' (Mountain View, California, 24 June 2000).<ref name="dt-7975">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7975 DII - Pre-Release Deck], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 27 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7975/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7975/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018154238/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7975/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''DII - Pre-Release Deck'''
* '''Author:''' Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder
* '''Published:''' June 27, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' My Dark Side Pre-Release deck

=== Strategy ===

I went 2/2 with this deck It has great battle potential and the fact that you can grab matching pilots to make your stuff Immune to Attrition is SWEET Lord Vader is cool...it'd be better w/a Lightsaber but hey that's just me.... enjoy and thanks for reading....and again please don't rate this deck poorly because it's a Pre-Release deck....and for the vitals...check ot the TR Mt.View CA 062400 for more in depth stuff.

Thanks Cat "The Garindan Collector" Ceder
